summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Judgments
summary.text: Astrological question list covering finding people, arrests, slavery, chariot races, horses, murder, royal honors, ambassadors and letters, rebels, found coins, travelers, friendship and enmity, lunar applications in nativities, and zodiacal colors. Kintes is praised, with a cross-reference to Codex Vindobonensis 2, folio 120, chapter 89.
